We are welcoming all prospective Reception 2027/28 families to our next open day in November. To register your interest, please contact the school on the following e-mail: admissions@tadworthps.surrey.sch.uk.

Governors
The Full Governing Body operates a committee structure and meets twice a term in their committee groups and at least once a term as a full group. Our governors act as ‘critical friends’ to the school. They attend meetings and help to determine the overall direction and vision as well as school policy. They help us to monitor developments within the school and provide a sounding board for dealing with issues of all kinds. They freely give their time to help the school and we are extremely grateful for all that they do. Governors attend all meetings of the Full Governing Body (FGB) and in addition, some are also members of sub Committees.
Information about our governors
Our Chair of Governors is Matt Tiplin.
Our Vice Chair role is currently held by Phil Harrison.

SEND
At Tadworth Primary School, we believe that every child has the right to access the full curriculum. The opportunity for all to develop skills through active engagement and enjoyment whilst learning alongside their peers, is central to our ethos. We acknowledge that support should be offered within the classroom environment, where possible, but recognise that there are also occasions when some children will receive support in a setting more suitable for their learning needs. We aim to work alongside other agencies providing both emotional and practical support for parents and children whose needs require multi-agency partnerships.
So that parents are aware of the support available from our school, and through services within Surrey, we provide additional information about this in our SEN Information Report (see link below). Further information about Surrey's Send Local Offer can be found by following this link.
We actively encourage parents to work in partnership with school to ensure that both the child and parents are central in the decision-making process in order to ensure our pupils have the best possible life chances.
If you have any concerns over any special educational need or disability which your son/daughter may have, you may like to discuss this with your child's class teacher or the school’s SENDCo, Mrs Sarah Davies. To contact Mrs Davies please email her; sdavies@tadworthps.surrey.sch.uk
or contact the front office on 01737 354541, choosing option 4.
Please see the below linked documents for further information on our provision for children with Special Educational Needs and Disabilities.
For more information about the services on offer from Surrey, please visit the Surrey Family Information Service.

Clubs
We have a wide range of clubs at Tadworth for children to enjoy both during and after school. Details of the club timetable for the forthcoming term will be emailed to all parents prior to the start of term. Spaces are on a first come first served basis and those run by the school can be booked via ARBOR. Please contact the school office for current information.
All clubs run by the school and PLL are on the Arbor parent portal/app. The clubs run at £4 per session (with the exception of Drama). If you qualify for Pupil Premium, please get in touch and we will be able to book your child in for x1 club of your choice on a first come/first served basis (subject to further details given directly to qualifying families).
All other clubs are run by independent companies/individuals and will need to be contacted directly; their contact information is on the club programme.
Wraparound is an independent service that uses our school site to provide breakfast and afterschool care. The provision is for the sole use of Tadworth Pupils and is available to book via the website. Full details can be found by following the link below.

A Message from the Headteacher
At Tadworth, our mission is simple: we want every child to ‘enjoy and achieve.’ We are dedicated to helping our pupils discover new passions and develop their unique talents through a rich variety of experiences that extend far beyond the classroom.
Our School
Inspiring Academic Excellence
We consistently achieve strong academic results by rooting fundamental skills in a curriculum designed to inspire and motivate. Learning is brought to life through:
A Creative Curriculum: Engaging lessons that transform education into an adventure.
The Arts: A vibrant culture of performance, including our popular KS2 drama club which stages a highly anticipated annual musical.
Enriching Trips and Visits: A well-established programme of outings and visiting speakers that sparks curiosity across all curriculum areas.
Reading and Enrichment
At our school, we want reading to be at the heart of every child's education. From our stunning library to the diverse collections in every classroom, we foster a lifelong passion for books. This love of learning is further supported by our wide selection of extracurricular clubs and hands-on experiences.
A Holistic Approach to Wellbeing
As proud holders of the Surrey Healthy Schools Award, we are deeply committed to the physical and emotional wellbeing of our pupils:
Nutritious Dining: Our in-house catering team, ‘Tadworth Treats’, provides delicious, balanced meals that the children really enjoy.
Sporting Spirit: Through our PE curriculum and diverse sports clubs, pupils learn the value of teamwork and sportsmanship. We take great pride in our students’ many successes in inter-school competitions.
Giving Back: Citizenship is central to our ethos; every year group supports a designated charity, helping children understand their place and impact in the wider world.
A Thriving School Community
We are fortunate to offer our pupils spacious grounds and modern, well-resourced classrooms. This environment is constantly enhanced by our active PTA, whose incredible fundraising efforts recently transformed our playgrounds and outdoor learning spaces.
Behind every success at Tadworth is a dedicated staff team and a highly experienced governing body, all working together to provide the best possible start for your child.
Visit Us
Choosing a school is one of the most important decisions you will make. The best way to experience the energy and warmth of Tadworth is to see it in action.
Visitors are always welcome—we look forward to showing you what makes our school so special.
Justin Kelly - Headteacher

ACADEMY CONVERSION
We are pleased to share an update on our journey towards becoming an academy within Bourne Education Trust (BET).
As you know, we are currently an Associate School with BET, and last term we consulted with parents and wider stakeholders on our proposal for Tadworth Primary School to convert to academy status and join BET fully.
Earlier this term, we received confirmation from the Department for Education that our Academy Order has been approved. Since then, we have been working through the legal processes required to move from being a Local Authority maintained school to an academy. Our current aim is to complete the conversion on 1 June 2026.
As part of our consultation in the autumn, we also sought feedback on a proposed change to our term dates so that they would align with those of other BET schools. Provided the conversion takes place on the planned date (1 June), our term dates for 2026–27 will follow the BET calendar rather than Surrey’s. These dates are available to view on our school website. They will be formally confirmed upon conversion to academy status.
